finding.claim: has_passed treats stale_after as passed only when it is strictly before now, but OKF 5.5 says a concept is stale when now >= stale_after. At the exact instant a concept is not reported due.

fixes.change: has_passed is true at or after stale_after (now >= stale_after), per OKF 5.5, with the docstring updated.
A test that has_passed is true at the exact stale_after instant and false one second before.
